name: Hawkeye Baked Buttermilk Chicken & Huntsman Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin (Marvel Day at Sea)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Marvel Day at Sea Dinner Menu
whyItWorks: Both the buttermilk-marinated baked chicken breast and roasted pork tenderloin are lean, high-protein mains.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for plain mashed potatoes or sweet potatoes (without the bell pepper hash) and gravy on the side; kids' menu Thor's Baked Cod is also a 9.5/10 flare swap.
watchOuts: Diced bell peppers in the standard sweet potato hash (request plain potato)
